<div class="wrap">
<h1>10-K / 10-Q tape</h1>
<p class="sub">Recent Form 10-K and 10-Q filings plus amendments from the live EDGAR index. An amendment is a restated or corrected filing, not a parsed accounting change. The feed has company name and CIK; no ticker is invented. Click a header to sort.</p>
<div class="kpis" id="kpis"></div>
<input id="q" placeholder="filter company, CIK, or form" autocomplete="off">
<div id="board">Loading /data/10kq-filings.json</div>
<div class="foot"><b>Built for:</b> seeing which issuers just filed a 10-K, 10-Q, or amendment without pretending the text was parsed.<br>
<b>Data:</b> /data/10kq-filings.json (stats, filings[], amended[] with form, company, cik, accession, filed_at, filing_url).<br>
<b>Not:</b> an MD&amp;A miner, an 8-K guidance parser, or a ticker map. Research only.</div>
</div>
<script>
function esc(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];});}
var SORT="filed_at", DIR=-1, PACK=null;
function cmp(a,b){
  var av=a[SORT], bv=b[SORT];
  if(av==null||av==="") return 1; if(bv==null||bv==="") return -1;
  if(SORT==="filed_at") return ((Date.parse(av)||0)-(Date.parse(bv)||0))*DIR;
  return String(av).localeCompare(String(bv))*DIR;
}
function paint(){
  var d=PACK; if(!d) return;
  var rows=(d.filings||[]).concat(d.amended||[]);
  var q=(document.getElementById("q").value||"").toUpperCase();
  rows=rows.filter(function(r){
    if(!q) return true;
    return (String(r.company||"")+" "+String(r.cik||"")+" "+String(r.form||"")+" "+String(r.accession||"")).toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0;
  }).sort(cmp);
  var h='<table><thead><tr>';
  [["filed_at","Filed"],["form","Form"],["company","Company"],["cik","CIK"],["accession","Accession"]].forEach(function(c){
    h+='<th class="'+(SORT===c[0]?"on":"")+'" data-k="'+c[0]+'">'+c[1]+(SORT===c[0]?(DIR<0?" \u2193":" \u2191"):"")+"</th>";
  });
  h+="</tr></thead><tbody>";
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    var amd=/\/A$/.test(r.form||"");
    h+="<tr><td>"+esc((r.filed_at||"").replace("T"," ").slice(0,19))+"</td>";
    h+='<td class="'+(amd?"amd":"")+'">'+esc(r.form||"")+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+(r.filing_url?"<a href=\""+esc(r.filing_url)+"\" target=_blank rel=noopener>"+esc(r.company||"")+"</a>":esc(r.company||""))+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+esc(r.cik||"")+"</td><td>"+esc(r.accession||"")+"</td></tr>";
  });
  document.getElementById("board").innerHTML=h+"</tbody></table><p class=sub>"+rows.length+" rows in the "+esc(d.window_days)+"-day window. Generated "+esc(d.generated_at||"")+". Amendments stay marked. No ticker invented.</p>";
  document.querySelectorAll("#board th[data-k]").forEach(function(el){
    el.onclick=function(){var k=el.getAttribute("data-k"); if(SORT===k)DIR=-DIR; else {SORT=k; DIR=k==="filed_at"?-1:1;} paint();};
  });
}
(async function(){
  var d=null;
  try{var r=await fetch("/data/10kq-filings.json?t="+Date.now(),{cache:"no-store"}); if(r.ok)d=await r.json();}catch(e){}
  if(!d){document.getElementById("board").textContent="10kq-filings.json missing.";return;}
  PACK=d; var st=d.stats||{};
  document.getElementById("kpis").innerHTML=
    '<span class="chip"><b>'+(st.total!=null?st.total:(d.filings||[]).length)+"</b> filings</span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><b>'+(st.total_10k||0)+"</b> 10-K</span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><b>'+(st.total_10q||0)+"</b> 10-Q</span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><b>'+((st.total_10k_amended||0)+(st.total_10q_amended||0))+"</b> amendments</span>";
  document.getElementById("q").oninput=paint; paint();
})();
</script>
